description: This file defines the UndeployedRelationships class, which manages relationships between modules that are not yet deployed in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It handles loading, saving, building, and modifying relationship configurations, including related layout modifications and integration with the ModuleBuilder.

classes.name: UndeployedRelationships
classes.description: A class that manages undeployed module relationships in SuiteCRM, including loading, saving, building, and layout modifications related to module relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UndeployedRelationships object with the module's base path, module, and package names, and loads saved relationships.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads saved relationship definitions for the module.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new relationship and updates undeployed layouts accordingly.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a relationship by name and removes associated layout fields.

methods.name: getAllRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves all relevant relationships, including those known to ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: enforceRelationshipOnly
methods.description: Flags relationships as 'relationship_only' if similar relationships exist.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds files for the module relationship, handling activities expansion and module string updates.

methods.name: addInstallDefs
methods.description: Adds this relationship's install definitions to a passed array for module installation.

methods.name: updateUndeployedLayout
methods.description: Adds or removes relationship fields from module layouts based on the relationship object.

methods.name: saveFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Adds relationship fields to module layouts if applicable.
